violation_type.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))
violation_type.short_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained
violation_type.typical_finding: The proper depth of loose fill is not being maintained on the playground.

finding_variants.text: The proper depth of loose fill is not being maintained on the playground.
The loose-fill surfacing material does not contain the proper depth.
The mulch around the playground climbing equipment must be maintained at proper depth.
The mulch in the playground area must be maintained at proper depth.
During the inspection I  observed the playground loose-fill material not to be maintained at the proper depth.
Observed the loose-fill materials not maintained at the proper depth as the black trap was accessible to the children as a tripping hazard at the time of inspection.
